summary: Full E2E testing of Website Maintenance / Coming Soon Mode feature. All 18 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing verified Coming Soon page display, email subscription, admin auth access, mode switching, and subscriber management.
critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceGuard in App.js correctly allows /auth and /admin routes through always
SiteModeContext provides global state via useSiteMode() hook
Admin email check uses @bidvex.com domain (current admin is charbeladmin@bidvex.com)
Site mode persists in MongoDB site_settings collection
Subscribers stored in launch_subscribers collection with proper deduplication
seed_data_creation: Created test email subscribers during testing - prefixed with TEST_ or playwright_test_
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site mode feature fully functional. Current state: coming_soon mode. Admin can toggle between live/maintenance/coming_soon. Subscriber management (list, export CSV, delete) all working.

1_get_site_mode_api.details: Returns current mode (coming_soon/maintenance/live) with optional message and expected_back

2_update_site_mode_api.details: Admin can update mode. Requires @bidvex.com email. Validates mode values.

3_subscribe_email_api.details: Saves email to launch_subscribers. Handles duplicates gracefully. Validates email format.

4_get_subscribers_api.details: Returns paginated list with search. Admin only.

6_delete_subscriber_api.details: Deletes by subscriber_id. Returns 404 for non-existent.

7_subscriber_stats_api.details: Returns total, today count, and 7-day trend

8_coming_soon_page_display.details: Displays when mode=coming_soon with BidVex branding, email form, feature highlights

9_email_subscription_ui.details: Form submits via POST /api/subscribe. Shows 'You're on the list!' success state.

10_admin_auth_access.details: /auth route accessible in maintenance/coming_soon mode (MaintenanceGuard allows it)

11_admin_panel_access.details: /admin route accessible after login. Shows Site Mode in Settings tab.

12_site_mode_manager_ui.details: Settings > Site Mode shows toggle, current mode badge, subscriber stats, CSV export

13_mode_switching_live.details: Switching to Live mode removes Coming Soon page and shows normal homepage

14_mode_persistence.details: Mode changes persist after save. Verified via API call after update.
